public_brief.objective: Keep the act alive in front of someone who might be the real thing, and still collect.
public_brief.tactic: Embrace the kinship claim loudly, then slip the passage toll in as an old custom.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The candlelight finds her eyes and holds there a beat too long. The four pale players go still; the fourth player's hand stops halfway to his coins. The dealer recovers first, spreading his fingers in welcome.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Cousin! Yes, of course, cousin. The blood calls to the blood, and we have kept a quiet court down here a long while. Still, even among the night's children there are customs. Passage through our hall is ten gold, a small tithe to the dead. You will honor our custom, surely?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: You will honor our custom, surely?
